title: A product of fields is absolutely flat

standard_prerequisites.name: A ring in which every finitely generated ideal is generated by an idempotent is absolutely flat, characterized by every prime being maximal and the local rings being fields
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the criterion invoked at the end.

core_obligations: For f = (f_i) in the product of fields, the ideal generated by f equals the ideal generated by the idempotent e = (e_i) with e_i = 0 or 1 according to whether f_i vanishes, since multiplication by the unit inverse on the support realizes f as e times a unit (proof lines 30294-30297). Hence D(f) = D(e) is both open and closed (proof lines 30297-30298). By the absolutely-flat criterion and the algebra lemma characterizing rings whose primes are all minimal, the product of fields is absolutely flat (proof lines 30298-30299).
proof_roadmap: Replace each element by an idempotent generating the same principal ideal (proof lines 30294-30297).
Conclude clopenness of D(f) and apply the absolute flatness criterion (proof lines 30297-30299).
